algorithm: raw-AST typed boxed-continuation CPS with bounded dependent request groups, dependency-first ordered match, projection values, bounded nonrecursive storage islands, bounded private-helper result deforestation and structurally recursive native heterogeneous-stack chunks
nativeTerminationClaim: Generated source handlers and continuation helpers form an acyclic declaration graph. Result-deforested producer and continuation helpers are private, acyclic and emitted before their users; each forwards the same affine fields and captures once. Only the native chunk scheduler is self-recursive, structurally decreasing an operational Nat on every RunState transition. Zero returns the remaining Run unchanged; RunFinished returns directly. Native push/pop transfers affine progress, resume and stack once, never reassociates Bound and never allocates composition closures. This does not alter canonical semantic fuel or claim termination of the complete host-driven computation.

boxedTransport.unboxing: One generic named parameter-match getter consumes the carrier; a single Let restores each authenticated source result quantity: Many for Data, Lone for affine Type; existing continuation helpers retain named parameter matches; no computed/local native matches or unsafe casts

nativeChunk.finishedTransport: native stack pop passes whole box to source resume; StackDone consumes checked equality through Value<_> and returns RunFinished
nativeChunk.stackOwnership: Affine heterogeneous native LIFO; no host stack, no Bound reassociation, no Compose nodes, no per-site constructors

loweringSourcePolicy: Original authenticated canonical declaration blocks under the owned native-provider header; computed and nested matches factored once by typed CPS, not pre-expanded into source requests.
administrativeQuantityPolicy: Live-use-directed Many promotion only for authenticated Data; canonical request quantities and erased binders unchanged

directInvocation.policy: Typed source closure only when target precedes owner in authenticated source order; erased request witness preserves exact result type; affine boxed resume uses one generic parameter-match getter and one quantity-preserving Let; live arguments transferred once into the affine closure; all public request handlers retained; future/self/backedge calls remain pending
directInvocation.arguments: Authentic Base False{}; unused scalar affine callback token; five-field Direct with boxed resume

tailCallFusion.policy: Identity Finished{Value{value}} continuation only; target precedes owner in authenticated source order; projection-only arguments with a live variable; typed target Progress and all request handlers retained; cycles and closed computations remain pending

resultDeforestation.policy: Compiler-private pure producer helpers returning one single-constructor record (Pair/ArenaResult/ArenaStore/...), immediately destructured by their single-use generated match consumer, are composed along the acyclic pure helper DAG: every tail record construction becomes one call to a shared continuation helper with the same fields and captures. Source request handlers, effectful step bodies, traced boundaries, semantic fuel and quantum 64 are untouched; captures are variables or erased terms, retained binders are alpha-freshened, fields are consumed once, and unfusable shapes (dependent fields, recursive or effectful producers, multiple consumers) are left as ordinary CPS.

pureCallClassification.policy: Live source argument required. Projections do not construct values or call functions. Checker arena wrappers and core_bound_unaffected may compose admitted helpers with native Arena/U32/Nat and IR.arena_* scalar range/bit calls and bounded constructors, in dependency order; this admits the nonrecursive arena view/accessor closure but no recursion, indirect calls or function binders. All other definitions retain CPS
